notes: Prompt: LIST-<token> then a numbered list of 60 short lines (a Run that streams for several seconds). B opens 1500 ms after A's list started streaming; A is dropped when B opens and returns 1200 ms later. Trials of one round run in parallel on one Stack, so timings include that contention.

Chat WebSocket has no snapshot frame: B-over-WS takes the snapshot over HTTP (cursor + the Run's partial_output), then conversation.subscribe(stream:true, after_cursor). B-over-CLI is `hatch conversation watch` (no snapshot, no cursor: 'from now'). Studio has no CLI watch.

defects.title: Chat: a client that resumes by cursor loses the text streamed while it was away
defects.expected: Spec: any client resumes from a cursor and sees no missing text (live deltas reach every observer).
defects.actual: Resuming at the last cursor (after_cursor / Last-Event-ID) replays only durable journal events. Text deltas carry no cursor and are not replayed, so 10 of 10 returning clients assembled a reply with missing text (missing chars: 454, 610, 524, 1047, 480, 490, 419, 527, 524, 537). The CLI's own resumable() stream uses exactly this path.
defects.repro: POST a long message with Accept: text/event-stream, drop the connection mid-stream, reconnect with GET events?after_cursor=<last cursor> (or Last-Event-ID), compare the concatenated deltas with the stored assistant message.

defects.title: Chat: snapshot + live events cannot be joined without gaps or duplicates
defects.expected: Snapshot (partial output + cursor) then events after that cursor gives continuous text.
defects.actual: The snapshot's partial_output is saved at most once a second and live deltas have no cursor or offset, so the join is inexact: 11 of 11 returning clients got missing or duplicated text ({"exact":0,"missing":11,"duplicated":0,"mismatch":0,"missing_chars":[211,279,95,200,99,204,220,81,187,93,114],"duplicated_chars":[]}).
defects.repro: While a Run streams, GET snapshot (runs[].partial_output, cursor), then GET events?after_cursor=<cursor> with Accept: text/event-stream; concatenate partial_output and the following deltas and compare with the stored message.

defects.title: hatch conversation watch started mid-Run prints only text from now
defects.expected: Opening a conversation on another client mid-Run shows the answer so far.
defects.actual: watch has no snapshot step; 6 of 6 watchers printed only the tail (missing chars 668, 626, 650, 593, 544, 751).
defects.repro: hatch ask <long prompt> --product P --conversation C --wait=1 ; hatch conversation watch C --product P two seconds later.

defects.title: Chat: a client opened mid-Run (snapshot then subscribe) shows missing or duplicated text
defects.expected: Snapshot partial output plus the following events equals the stored reply.
defects.actual: 16 of 16 B clients (SSE / WebSocket) were not exact: {"exact":0,"missing":16,"duplicated":0,"mismatch":0,"missing_chars":[93,195,166,225,116,118,92,219,92,119,88,97,107,102,364,192],"duplicated_chars":[]}.
defects.repro: Same as above, from a second client while the first is still streaming.
